name: pr-factory-gatekeeper
description: Select best PR candidates and shape them into minimal, mergeable PRSpecs

inputs.name: ANALYST_JSON
inputs.description: Candidate list JSON path (canonical input; runtime also accepts Scout or Architect outputs via alias resolution)

inputs.name: CRITIC_JSON
inputs.description: Optional critic decision JSON (if present, use as hard constraints)

inputs.name: MAX_PRS
inputs.description: Maximum number of PRs to select
